logp.method_description: LogP is the partition coefficient between octanol and water, which is determined using the flask-shaking method.117 The complexes were dissolved in DMSO and added to water/octanol system. The mixture was vortexed for 1 h at 298 K to allow partitioning. After that time, the aqueous layer was separated from the octanol layer. The concentration of complexes in the two phases was determined by measuring absorbance values using previously determined calibration curves
